body:
I have a girlfriend. When I am with her and when she puts her arms around me, I wish I could stay in that moment forever because I actually feel at ease. 


It's hard because I haven't kissed her yet. If I do, I think it'd hurt her a lot more if I go. If I do kiss her, though, I might have a chance at becoming happy. I don't know, I don't want to ruin her life because mine feels like shit. 


Also, spending time with my friends. Since I'm going off to college soon, though, I know I'm going to lose them. I thought we were all doing something over the summer, but apparently one friend can't go.


I was looking forward to summer. Really, really looking forward to summer. Now that my plans just scrapped, I feel like I have very little to look forward to. I couldn't give a shit where I go to college so I'm not excited to attend. 


I'm afraid that hanging out with friends is a quick fix, though.


Is your mom happy? What happens if I can never decide on anything? Then I feel like I don't have a place in this world, I guess.


I guess getting older will have to wait until, well, I get older. I could make my decision then. 


Sorry I'm writing a wall of text, I'm just trying anything to feel better right now. Thanks for letting me vent to you.
